quizName:
Hardest Questions in Wisconsin
									  					
									  														  					Most difficult questions from your region.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: U-turns are not allowed at this location.

questions.question: You miss your turn or exit on a freeway. What should you do?

options.text: Make the turn quickly from your current lane.
Keep driving until you find the next turn, exit, or safe place to turn around.
Signal other drivers to stop so you can turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep driving until you find the next turn, exit, or safe place to turn around.
questions.explanation: Do not back up or turn around on a freeway. Continue to the next exit or turn where it is safe to turn around. Backing up on a freeway is illegal.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This warning sign (yellow with black markings) tells you a steep hill is coming. Slow down to avoid brake problems or crashes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Be ready for traffic to merge into your lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be ready for traffic to merge into your lane.
questions.explanation: This warning sign (yellow with black markings) tells you traffic will merge from the right. Be ready to let them in safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This warning sign (yellow with black markings) tells you traffic is coming toward you from the opposite direction.

questions.question: If you are in a serious car crash, what should you do?
questions.explanation: Stop your car if possible. Call 911 if anyone is hurt and help them. Report the crash to police if someone is injured, killed, or if damage is over $1,000 (or over $200 to government property like signs).

questions.question: At a crosswalk, who has the right-of-way?

options.text: Construction workers must yield to you.

questions.explanation: Pedestrians have the right-of-way at crosswalks. You must stop for them, whether the crosswalk is marked or not. Pedestrians must obey traffic signals.

questions.question: You are angry after an upsetting event at work. When you get to your car, you should:

options.text: Play the radio loudly to distract yourself.
Drive fast on the highway to release anger.
Take a few minutes to calm down before driving.
Stop for a drink before driving home.

questions.correctAnswerText: Take a few minutes to calm down before driving.
questions.explanation: Cool off before driving if you are upset or angry. Driving while emotional is dangerous to you and others on the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Circular signs warn of railroad crossings. Watch for trains when you see this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They warn drivers about hazards ahead. This sign tells you the road may be slippery when wet. Your vehicle may be harder to control.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign shows the direction traffic must go on this street.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign works with a traffic signal. It means drivers turning left at a green light must yield to oncoming traffic. Turn left only when it is safe.

questions.question: What should you do if you become tired while driving?

options.text: Stop to rest or change drivers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop to rest or change drivers.
questions.explanation: If you feel tired while driving, stop to rest or let someone else drive. Tiredness slows your reactions and makes it unsafe to drive.

questions.question: In a vehicle with airbags, where should children age 12 and under sit?

options.text: The bed of a pick-up truck.

questions.explanation: Airbags can be dangerous for children. Children age 12 and under should always sit in the back seat of a vehicle with airbags.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn. You cannot turn around and go in the opposite direction where this sign is posted.

questions.question: When is it important to slow down?

options.text: When the road is wet or slippery.

questions.explanation: You should slow down on narrow or winding roads, at intersections, at railroad crossings, on hills, in sharp or blind curves, where there are pedestrians, and when roads are wet or slippery.

questions.question: A traffic signal is green and a police officer signals you to stop. What should you do?

options.text: Do what the vehicle in front of you does.

questions.explanation: You must always obey a police officer's directions, even if they contradict traffic signals, signs, or road markings.

questions.question: What can impair a driver's ability to drive?
questions.explanation: Driving ability is impaired by alcohol, legal and illegal drugs, and being drowsy. Safe driving requires good physical condition.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street the wrong way.
Do not drive in this lane.
Traffic turning left on the green light must yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic turning left on the green light must yield to oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign is used with a traffic signal. It tells drivers turning left at a green light that they do not have the right-of-way. Wait for oncoming traffic to pass before turning left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a regulation sign. It tells drivers what they must do. This sign means you cannot turn left.

questions.question: How can alcohol affect your driving?

options.text: It makes you feel more confident than you should be.
It affects your ability to think clearly.

questions.explanation: Alcohol affects the parts of your brain that control judgment and self-control. You may feel overly confident. Alcohol also slows your reaction time, hurts your balance, and makes it hard to judge distance. This makes it difficult to react to what is happening around you.

questions.question: When pulled over for a traffic violation or equipment check, you must show:
questions.explanation: When pulled over, you must show your driver's license, proof of registration, and proof of insurance. You must have all three documents with you whenever you drive.

questions.question: If you feel drowsy while driving, what should you do?
questions.explanation: If you feel tired while driving, stop at the nearest rest stop to take a nap, stretch, or let someone else drive. Caffeine pills and energy drinks are not safe replacements for rest and can make driving more dangerous.

questions.question: What can cause distracted driving?

options.text: Talking or texting on a cell phone.
Changing the radio station or CD.

questions.explanation: Drivers must make about 200 decisions for every mile driven. You need to focus completely on driving. Any extra activity can distract you and create danger.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Watch for people crossing your path.

questions.explanation: This orange warning sign tells you that road work is coming up. Stay alert for temporary traffic control devices when driving through a work zone.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Parking spaces reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
Traffic in this lane must turn in the direction of the arrow.
Lanes are reserved for buses and vehicles with multiple passengers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Parking spaces reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces that are reserved only for people with disabled parking permits.

questions.question: Anything that requires you to ____ could cause a crash.

options.text: Take your eyes off the road
Take your hands off the wheel
Take your attention away from driving

questions.explanation: A distraction is anything that takes your attention away from driving, takes your eyes off the road, or takes your hands off the wheel.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Wet roads are slippery and dangerous. This sign warns you that conditions may cause you to lose control. Slow down on wet pavement because it takes longer to stop.

questions.question: This sign shows one type of:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert you to conditions coming up ahead. This sign warns that another road crosses the highway ahead.

questions.question: If you have an argument with another person and are angry, you should:

options.text: Play the radio loudly while driving so you won't think about the argument.
Wait a few minutes to calm down before driving.
Drive on the interstate to let off steam.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait a few minutes to calm down before driving.
questions.explanation: Strong emotions affect your ability to drive safely. If you are very angry, excited, scared, worried, or sad, wait until you are calm before driving. You need to focus on driving without thinking about what upset you.

questions.question: Like alcohol and other drugs, drowsiness can:
questions.explanation: Not getting enough sleep causes poor driving. Sleepiness slows your reaction time, reduces awareness, and weakens judgment, just like drugs and alcohol do.

questions.question: Before turning, you should:
questions.explanation: To turn safely, turn on your signal three to four seconds before you turn.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings warn drivers about hazards or special conditions. Round signs warn only about railroad crossings ahead.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to areas where bicycles, animals, people, or vehicles are likely to cross.

questions.question: If you encounter an aggressive driver, you should:
questions.explanation: All drivers must respect other road users and follow traffic rules to prevent crashes. When you meet an aggressive driver, the safest choice is to move out of their way. Never try to compete with other drivers.

questions.question: Alcohol causes:
questions.explanation: Even small amounts of alcohol harm your vision, judgment, focus, and coordination.

questions.question: This sign warns that you are approaching:
questions.explanation: A round sign means a railroad crossing is ahead. This sign is placed a few hundred feet before the tracks. It tells drivers to slow down, look, listen, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: If you reach a railroad crossing with lowered gates and flashing warning lights, you should:

options.text: Drive around the gates if you don't see a train.
Stop completely behind the gates. Wait until the tracks are clear, then proceed after the gates are raised.
Slow down and drive around the gates.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely behind the gates. Wait until the tracks are clear, then proceed after the gates are raised.
questions.explanation: You must stop at a railroad crossing when signs, warning devices, or flaggers alert you to a train. It is illegal to drive around lowered gates.

questions.question: When you encounter an aggressive driver, you should:

options.text: Avoid eye contact, slow down, and let them pass.
Cut them off to slow them down.
Show them you don't approve of their behavior.

questions.correctAnswerText: Avoid eye contact, slow down, and let them pass.
questions.explanation: If another driver is threatening you or driving dangerously near you, stay calm. Slow down and let them pass. Create distance between your vehicles. Do not make eye contact or make rude gestures.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It tells you not to drive in that direction.

questions.question: When approaching railroad tracks, you should:

options.text: Look, listen, slow down, and be ready to stop.
Speed up to cross the tracks before the gate closes.
Try to drive around a lowered gate.
Not pay attention to how many tracks there are.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look, listen, slow down, and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: When approaching railroad tracks, look and listen for trains. Slow down and be ready to stop if needed.

questions.question: When turning or changing lanes, you must:

options.text: Always signal, even when no other cars are visible.
Signal only if there is other traffic.
Signal only when driving at night.
Signal only in heavy traffic at night.

questions.correctAnswerText: Always signal, even when no other cars are visible.
questions.explanation: Always signal when changing lanes, turning, or pulling away from a curb. Make this a habit, not just something you do when you think others are watching.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs mean you must stop. Yield the right-of-way at the intersection. You may proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: If you must make an emergency stop on an interstate, you should:

options.text: Honk your horn to get the attention of passing cars.
Get out and wave down the first vehicle that passes.
Pull off the road, turn on your emergency flashers, and stay in your vehicle if you can.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull off the road, turn on your emergency flashers, and stay in your vehicle if you can.
questions.explanation: Pull to the shoulder and turn on your emergency flashers to warn other drivers. Stay in your vehicle if possible. Standing or walking on an interstate is very dangerous because of the high-speed traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road ahead has many curves.

questions.question: When you see a school bus stopped with its stop arm out, you should:

options.text: Come to a complete stop and wait.
Honk and pass on the left.
Drive on when you think all the kids are done getting off.
Pass the bus before its door opens.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a complete stop and wait.
questions.explanation: You must come to a complete stop when a school bus has its stop arm out. Do not go until the arm is raised.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The traffic light ahead is red.
The traffic light ahead is broken.
The traffic light ahead is green.
There is a traffic light ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic light ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that there is a traffic light at the next intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash through it means something is not allowed. This sign means you cannot make a U-turn.

questions.question: You are borrowing an unfamiliar vehicle from a friend. You should:

options.text: Not worry about it because all vehicles are the same.
Not tell your friend you are unfamiliar with the vehicle.
Ignore any obvious problems to avoid embarrassing your friend.
Take a few minutes to learn where the controls are and how they work before driving.

questions.correctAnswerText: Take a few minutes to learn where the controls are and how they work before driving.
questions.explanation: Before driving an unfamiliar vehicle, take time to find and understand the turn signals, hazard lights, headlights, wipers, brakes, gear shift, and horn. Fix any problems before you drive.
